# base:   rpc_response_base only (status, untrusted) :101-112
# SIGNEDNESS DIFFERS BETWEEN get_limit AND set_limit, and it is not cosmetic: get_limit's two fields
#         are uint64_t (:1867-1868) while set_limit's are int64_t (:1896-1897), because -1 means
#         "reset to the default" on the way IN and set_limit echoes that same signed type back
#         (set_limit.json). DESIGN.md §5b types NetStatus.limit_*_kbps as Option<i64> so one field
#         can carry both answers.
# UNITS ARE kB/s -- all of them, for get and set alike; upstream's own comment is on the set_limit
#         request field (:1883).
# gate:   OPEN. MAP_URI_AUTO_JON2("/get_limit", ...) has NO !m_restricted guard
#         (src/rpc/core_rpc_server.h:135), unlike /set_limit (:136). So node.net.limit_*_kbps stays
#         populated on a restricted node even though total_bytes_* goes null (DESIGN.md §5).
# LEGACY TRANSPORT ONLY: POST /get_limit; there is no json_rpc get_limit.
# VALUES are the worked example of DESIGN.md §5: limit_up 2048, limit_down 8192.
